extension.description: Repository containing 01xKeven add-ons: Balandro Bridge Multi and IMDb Parental Guide. Balandro Bridge Multi requires the "Balandro" add-on (plugin.video.balandro) to be installed and is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with the Balandro developers.
